BSC Testnet evidence

The rehearsal contract is live on BSC Testnet. The price digest was anchored and wallet A was paid. The vault received 6,000,000 wei tBNB and has a zero balance. A second claim was rejected with DuplicateClaim in an eth_call. The period ended before the 400-share transfer to B.
